equipment.name: Fire Hydrant & Hose Reel, Ground North
equipment.visual_signature: red hose reel drum in a glass-fronted wall cabinet, canvas hose coiled on the drum
equipment.manual_snippet: Break glass, pull the full length of hose out before opening the valve. Not for live electrical fires.

equipment.name: Manual Call Point, First Floor South
equipment.visual_signature: small red square call point at shoulder height beside the staircase door, hinged cover over the button
equipment.manual_snippet: Press only on confirmed fire. Activation sounds the building alarm and notifies the gate. Reset needs the security key.

equipment.name: Fire Extinguisher, Third Floor East
equipment.visual_signature: red cylindrical extinguisher on a wall bracket, pressure gauge on the neck, service tag on the handle
equipment.manual_snippet: Check the gauge is in the green band. PASS: pull pin, aim at the base, squeeze, sweep.

equipment.name: Fire Sand Bucket, Ground Floor
equipment.visual_signature: conical red bucket on a wall-mounted stand, filled with dry sand, stencilled FIRE in white
equipment.manual_snippet: For small liquid or metal fires only. Keep the sand dry.
